evidence.summary: Awin's own merchant profile for THE GOOD CHOCOLATE lists the program highlights: 10% affiliate commission, a 30-day cookie, a 10% standard customer coupon, special holiday coupons and optional collaborations (giveaways, contests, sale events). reasons.opportunity_availability: Open program on Awin, a major network.
reasons.credibility: Award-winning San Francisco chocolatier; first US chocolate certified FODMAP-friendly.
